mapper.select: SELECT account.subject_id, account.login_name, account.status FROM organization_access.subject_identity account WHERE account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lower(account.login_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership member WHERE member.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.subject_id = account.subject_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding platform_binding WHERE platform_binding.subject_id = account.subject_id AND platform_binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND platform_binding.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY lower(account.login_name), account.subject_id
